references.title: DWDS: schon
references.supports: Adverb with no Wortzerlegung; Etymologie: from the umlautless adverb of schön, ahd. scōno, split from the adjective in meaning

notes.rationale: Ich bin schon gerade eitel genug, 'as it is, already'. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, an indeclinable one with no Ending (ADR 0051): the Root schon alone.
